statement: Let Y be a smooth complex projective variety of dimension n. Suppose Y has numerically independent unsplit covering families V 1, . . . , V k with anticanonical degrees n1 + 1, . . . , nk + 1, where each nj is positive and P j nj = n. Then Y ∼ = Pn1 × · · · × Pnk .
